tasks.instruction: Uzupelnij kazdy z ponizszych dialogow (1.1-1.6), wybierajac odpowiedz A, B lub C.

items.stem:
Doctor: What seems to be the trouble?
Patient: _________
options: A) There's no trouble at all, thank you.
B) I've had a sore throat and a temperature since Monday.
C) I'm sorry to have caused you so much trouble.

items.stem:
Doctor: How long have you been feeling like this?
Patient: _________
options: A) Since about a week now.
B) From about a week now.
C) For about a week now.

items.stem:
Doctor: I'll give you something for the pain. Are you allergic to anything?
Patient: _________
options: A) Not that I know of.
B) Yes, I'm allergic to the pain.
C) No, I don't know anything.

items.stem:
X: The doctor has told me to cut down on salt.
Y: _________
options: A) That's easier to be said than done.
B) That's easier said than done.
C) That's easier saying than doing.

items.stem:
Doctor: Take one tablet three times a day, after meals.
Patient: _________
options: A) Right. Should I finish the whole meal even if I feel better?
B) Right. Should I take three meals after every tablet?
C) Right. Should I finish the whole course even if I feel better?

items.stem:
X: I've been told I need to have an operation.
Y: _________
options: A) Oh no. Try not to worry - you're in good hands.
B) Oh no. Try not to worry - you're in good health.
C) Oh no. Try not to worry - you're in good time.
